fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) rose 5.5% following SK Hynix's strong earnings announcement, which projects supply shortages through 2030.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix Q3 operating profit of KRW 83.3 trillion (+632% YoY), revenue of KRW 104.6 trillion (+328%) significantly exceeded consensus; three years' supply pre-sold.
